why_not_merged: 2,536 lines is 0.55% of the tree, and the controller's logical-case detector reported a single unexplained case delta (3,925 -> 3,924) that could not be traced to a removed #[test] in either version of the file it named. A marginal saving is not worth merging an unexplained assertion delta. The measurement is kept; the diff is not.
refusals_with_reasons: Remaining ~27,936 LOC to target not available without removing live product: fleet fabric, YOU, personalize, compat, program-runtime, and the backend host integration surface.
Orphan crates (hide-browser, hide-connectors, hide-objects, hide-sdk, hide-state) are self-tested product schemas and workspace members, not dead code.
hide-core::automation (~1,716 LOC, zero external callers) is the designed YOU automation engine with a non-widening PermissionSet.
Dual event models (hide-core::event vs hide-protocol) are must_not_delete until the Bridge lane; the inventory and sealed negatives forbid collapsing them here.
Crate merges that would not delete compiled code were deferred rather than paper-merged, because merge-without-delete earns zero credit.
controller_error_corrected: The first attempt returned zero eliminated because the contract forbade Cargo.toml -- making crate merges impossible -- and forbade hawking-context, where ClassedMemorySystem actually lives. Both were reopened for the second attempt, which is why this refusal is a measurement rather than a scoping artifact.

floor.note: HIDE is 25% of the 458,272 tree and does not condense materially without removing live product. Relocating it out of the monorepo earns zero credit under this campaign.
